title: A common dimension bound for an open cover bounds the whole space
statement: Let X be a quasi-sober T₀ topological space and U_i, indexed by any type ι, open subsets whose union is X [def-kun-subspace-topology]. Let d in WithBot ℕ∞ bound the topological Krull dimension of every U_i [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Then the topological Krull dimension of X is at most d. Empty spaces and empty members of the cover are allowed.

source.place: Topology, Lemma Tag 0B7I, chain argument in the proof; also the already proved source-library theorem at WeilConjectures/Mathlib/Topology/KrullDimension.lean:67

proof.text: The attached source-library proof unfolds topologicalKrullDim and applies Order.krullDim_eq_iSup_coheight to irreducible closed subsets. For an irreducible closed Z, quasi-sobriety and T₀ identify Z with its generic point using irreducibleSetEquivPoints. Choose a covering U_i containing that point. The open subspace is quasi-sober. Order.coheight_orderIso transfers the coheight of Z to that of the generic point; IsOpenEmbedding.coheight_eq for U_i identifies this with its coheight in U_i, and coheight_le_topologicalKrullDim bounds it by dim U_i, hence by d. Take the supremum. The open-subspace irreducible-closed correspondence explains the coheight invariance; this is the specialization-order realization of the chain argument in Tag 0B7I. If X is empty, the supremum is bottom.
